title: Loanwords: origin and accepted Aruban form

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Language of origin: nl, en, es, fr, pt, it (Italian), la (Latin), de (German), or other. other means AB 2018 does not tell which language the word comes from: §12.2 lists Dutch, English and French words together, and its list d (p. 44) holds words from brand or product names. The row's notes say which case applies.

fields.name: original
fields.description: Spelling in the language of origin

fields.name: accepted
fields.description: Whether the loan is accepted in writing

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the reviewers, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Printed page number(s), e.g. 38 or 38-39, roman for front matter.
